findings.message: Password reset tokens are now generated with `random.choices`, which uses the non-cryptographic Mersenne Twister PRNG; its output can be predicted after observing enough values, letting an attacker forge reset tokens and take over accounts. The previous `secrets.token_urlsafe(32)` was already URL-safe.
The change alters how reset tokens are generated but adds no test covering the new token format or length.
